name: grimmsnarl_ml_vfinal
policy: v22's policy verbatim: the same 60-card list, the same 2,000-tree ranker pinned to same-deck pilot 16371703 (observed rating 1220.2), the same fallback policy and one-ply planner, byte for byte.  The turn_search module ships with the agent but is disabled: it is the record of the experiment that was run to try to beat v22, not a behaviour change.

policy_escalation.effective_runtime: no separate escalation: the global teacher pin is already code 0

known_limits: Marnie’s Grimmsnarl ex is Grass-Weak and Teal Mask Ogerpon ex’s Myriad Leaf Shower reaches (30 + 30 x energies on both Actives) x 2, so from three Energy it one-shots our 320 HP two-prize attacker every turn while Shadow Bullet needs two turns back.  0-13 against Ogerpon at 950+ is structural, not a policy defect: over 86 such attacks our Active held 2.00 Energy on average, exactly the Shadow Bullet cost, so there is nothing to stop feeding.
Repairing Ogerpon, Hydrapple and Mega Lopunny/Froslass to 0.500 is worth about +47 Elo in the 950+ band, which is the whole identified matchup budget on this 60.
Grimmsnarl ex appears in 0 of 62 decks observed among the current top-35 teams, so no fresh same-deck teacher exists to retrain against.
description: The measured champion: v22’s policy, with the within-turn search experiment shipped disabled and fully documented.

turn_search.idea: Enumerate the remainder of our own turn through the official cg.api search entry points and overrule the ranker only when a different first action leads to a line taking strictly more prizes on every determinization sampled.  Unlike v7/v11/v27 it never searches past the end of our own turn, so it needs no belief over the opponent hand and no value model.

arena.design: 320-game local mirror, seats alternating, calibrated against a null control of v22 versus a byte-identical copy of itself.

turn_search.verdict: The extra prizes are real and committing collects them - 36 against the ranker’s 10 over 23 opportunities - but the more faithfully the prize-maximal line is executed the worse the agent plays. Prizes taken this turn is not a sufficient objective for a turn, and the layer is therefore off.

rejected_alternatives.v28: lost the same 400-game paired arena to v22 at 0.4475 [0.400, 0.497]
